jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a farm at sunset in thin white line art: a wooden fence, a small barn, fields. Scene: three neighbours drawn all in WHITE stand in a row in front of the fence, each raising both arms above their head and cheering with big smiles; behind the fence four white horses stand in the corral. All other people are figures drawn all in WHITE (white clothes, white fills, thin dark outlines), NOT coloured, NOT yellow, NOT black-filled, no dark silhouettes. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
